*Hypercapnoea: PaCO~2~ \>40mmHg*

+-----------+-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| CVS       | **Heart:**                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
|           |                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
|           | - ↑Catecholamines                                                                                                                                                                                           |
|           |   - Hypertension, tachycardia                                                                                                                                                                               |
|           |   - ±Arrhythmias, ischaemia                                                                                                                                                                                 |
|           | - Acidosis → negative inotropy                                                                                                                                                                              |
|           |   - Predominates at pH \<7.2                                                                                                                                                                                |
|           |                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
|           | **Vasculature:**                                                                                                                                                                                            |
|           |                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
|           | - Systemic vasodilation (↓SVR)                                                                                                                                                                              |
|           | - Pulmonary vasoconstriction (↑PVR)                                                                                                                                                                         |
+-----------+-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Resp      | **Hypoxaemia:**                                                                                                                                                                                             |
|           |                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
|           | - PAO~2~ = PiO~2~ – PaCO~2~ / R                                                                                                                                                                             |
|           | - N.B. supplemental O~2~ very effective                                                                                                                                                                     |
|           |                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
|           | ![](/content/exams/anzca/2021/B/11/prize-image001.jpg){fig-alt="Alveolar carbon dioxide tension against alveolar ventilation with inspired oxygen fractions required to normalise arterial oxygen tension"} |
|           |                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
|           | **Compensation:**                                                                                                                                                                                           |
|           |                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
|           | - Bohr effect                                                                                                                                                                                               |
|           |   - OHDC right shift → ↑tissue oxygenation                                                                                                                                                                  |
|           | - Stimulation of central and peripheral chemoreceptors → ↑V~A~ → ↓PaCO~2~                                                                                                                                   |
+-----------+-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| CNS       | **Vasodilation:**                                                                                                                                                                                           |
|           |                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
|           | - ↑CBF, ↑CBV, ±↑ICP                                                                                                                                                                                         |
|           | - Luxury perfusion: e.g. post-stroke, post-ROSC                                                                                                                                                             |
|           |                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
|           | ![](/content/exams/anzca/2021/B/11/prize-image002.jpg){fig-alt="Cerebral blood flow against arterial carbon dioxide tension"}                                                                               |
|           |                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
|           | **Narcosis:**                                                                                                                                                                                               |
|           |                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
|           | - Sedation 60-80mmHg, anaesthesia 80-100mmHg                                                                                                                                                                |
|           | - ↓MAC, ↓propofol Cp~50~                                                                                                                                                                                    |
+-----------+-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Acid-base | **Effects:**                                                                                                                                                                                                |
|           |                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
|           | - Respiratory acidosis                                                                                                                                                                                      |
|           |   - ↑10mmHg CO~2~ → pH ↓0.08 if acute (0.03 if chronic)                                                                                                                                                     |
|           |   - ↑10mmHg CO~2~ → HCO~3~^-^ ↑1mM acute (4mM chronic)                                                                                                                                                      |
|           |                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
|           | **Kinetics:**                                                                                                                                                                                               |
|           |                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
|           | - Transport: in RBC as \~60% HCO~3~^-^, 30% carbamino, 10% dissolved                                                                                                                                        |
|           | - Distribution: diffusion into cells, conversion to H^+^ + HCO~3-~                                                                                                                                          |
|           |                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
|           | ![](/content/exams/anzca/2021/B/11/prize-image003.jpg){fig-alt="Carbonic anhydrase equilibrium between carbon dioxide, water, carbonic acid, hydrogen ions and bicarbonate"}                                |
|           |                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
|           | - Buffering: 99% ICF (imidazole, phosphate), 1% ECF                                                                                                                                                         |
|           | - Compensation: ↑fixed acid excretion in urine → ↑HCO~3~^-^                                                                                                                                                 |
+-----------+-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
